name: Mahiru no Ankoku
source:
Tama New Town, 2028.
Those were happy, peaceful days... I think.
But once my older sister disappeared... Everything started breaking down.
Mom and dad left too. Everyone dear to me was no more.

But Sensei appeared instead. He's very kind and gentle.
Will he protect me from the killer?
Can we be friends?

Will he not abandon me?

[Translated from [url=http://summertimeinblue.net/mahiru]official site[/url]]
translation:
多摩新城，2028年。

那曾是幸福而平静的日子……我想。

可自从姐姐失踪后……一切都开始崩坏。
爸爸和妈妈也离开了。所有珍爱的人都不在了。

但老师出现了。他非常善良温柔。
他会保护我不被凶手杀死吗？
我们能成为朋友吗？

他不会抛弃我吧？

[译自[url=http://summertimeinblue.net/mahiru]官方网站[/url]]
